title: Hub-First Discovery A/B Protocol V4
objective: Test whether generalist professional information hubs materially increase event recall, sector breadth and weekly opportunity frequency without changing downstream V1.9 selection rules.

A.name: legacy_concentrated_discovery
A.sourceDefinition: Existing 2025 quarterly source packs and their frozen event clusters.

B.name: hub_first_discovery
B.sourceDefinition: Broad generalist-hub event discovery using generic state-change primitives without sector preselection; original facts recovered after hub detection.

C.name: hub_first_plus_validation
C.sourceDefinition: Arm B plus original-source and specialist validation after event discovery.

requiredHubCoverage.proxyRule: When paid historical terminals are unavailable, a public-web archive from the same broad professional publisher may be used only as an exploratory proxy and must be labeled proxy_not_terminal.

acceptance.sourceLayerOnly: Prefer B/C over A only if recall or opportunity-week frequency rises materially and 60d excess quality is not materially degraded.
acceptance.nextStepIfRecallImprovesButQualityFalls: Keep hub-first discovery but optimize timing/absorption separately on a different window.
